{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse with a relaxed fit, straight cut, #f6e4df color, woven silk fabric.
Charcoal grey wool-blend straight-leg trousers, full length, #3e4247 color, heavy wool blend fabric.
Tan leather ankle boots, pointed toe, mid-calf length, #c19d8a color, smooth calfskin leather.
This ensemble balances comfort with a polished look for a cool autumn day walking through the city. The relaxed blouse provides ease of movement while the tailored trousers maintain structure against the chill. Earthy tones in the neutral palette harmonize seamlessly with her warm skin undertones and blonde hair."}
